validation_scope: JSON parsing, bounded-regex compilation and invented string fixtures only
purpose: Find review candidates and preserve detector-negative sampling strata; never determine truth, causality, efficacy, forecast fulfillment, speaker identity or evidence quality from regex.
language_scope: English source text with recorded language provenance; not a language detector

engine_contract.large_anchor_handling: Scan bounded overlapping slices within the same anchor; map matches to the original text version and deduplicate by rule ID and global span.
engine_contract.anchor_assignment: First evidence token; adjacent context is retained separately.
engine_contract.match_offsets: Unicode code-point indices, half-open [start,end), in the exact matched text version
engine_contract.normalization: Do not modify source text in place. Any normalized view requires its own version/hash and mappings back to raw evidence.

review_dimensions: speaker versus quoted or reported source
physical versus audio/music versus metaphorical sense
reported measurement versus inspected evidence versus appraisal

rules.interpretation: Possible future-oriented wording; promises, schedules, questions and names can match.
Possible target-window wording; no actual future date or forecast status is inferred.
Candidate conditional wording; attachment and antecedent require context.
positive_examples: If the test succeeds, repeat it.
It may change depending on attendance.

rules.interpretation: Candidate negation cue only; not a polarity or contradiction decision.
negative_examples: The result supports the stated estimate.

rules.interpretation: Candidate reported-speech context; does not identify the speaker or endorse the claim.
positive_examples: The guest said the result was unexpected.
According to the report, attendance rose.

rules.interpretation: Scientific vocabulary candidate; saying testable does not establish a valid operational hypothesis.
Candidate experiment or replication terminology; an actual study and its design need independent inspection.
Candidate apparatus vocabulary; musical instruments and unverified measurement stories can match.
Candidate design terminology; no assignment of study quality or causal validity.
positive_examples: The trial was randomized and blinded.

rules.interpretation: A numeric frequency-unit mention; physical measurement, mechanism and truth remain unclassified.
positive_examples: A tone was set to 1.5 kHz.
negative_examples: The speaker used a high vibration metaphor.

rules.interpretation: Frequency-unit wording; its measured variable and evidence still require review.
positive_examples: They stated ten cycles per second.

rules.interpretation: Candidate metaphorical wording, intentionally overlapping physical uses; high frequency may be literal.
Audio/music context candidate; does not by itself settle physical versus metaphorical sense.
positive_examples: The tone has a high pitch.

rules.interpretation: Candidate healing or treatment wording, including denials and metaphors; not efficacy or medical advice.
positive_examples: They claim this treatment heals pain.
This does not cure an illness.

rules.interpretation: Candidate mechanism assertion; existence, measurement and clinical effects require separate evidence appraisal.
Possible personal-experience wording; not proof of causality, diagnosis or independent replication.
positive_examples: I felt better after the session.
